## State and behavior contract

Stateless typed direction/gap/alignment/wrap layout over `View`; `HStack` defaults cross-axis alignment to center (still overridable) and `VStack` is the vertical specialization — no controlled state.

### Props

#### `HStackProps`

This type adds no fields of its own. These are the props the implementation reads from the base type below; everything else is passed straight through.

| Prop | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `align` | `'center'` |


Also carries every prop of `Omit<StackProps, 'direction'>` — documented on the [Stack](/docs/components/stack/) page, not reproduced here.

#### `StackProps`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | — | — |

Also carries every prop of `ViewProps` and `VariantProps<typeof stackVariants>` — that upstream contract is not reproduced here.

#### `VStackProps`

_No own fields; this type is exactly the base(s) below._

Also carries every prop of `Omit<StackProps, 'direction'>` — documented on the [Stack](/docs/components/stack/) page, not reproduced here.

The executable fixtures below are the source-grounded usage examples; consumers should not infer state ownership from DOM structure or another UI library.

## Provider and dependencies

- No additional provider is required by this family. `BeeUIProvider` remains the recommended application root.
- **Peer/native dependencies visible to this Registry item:** `react`, `react-native`
- **Registry dependency closure:** `core-cn`, `theme`
- Safe-area ownership remains explicit: shell surfaces touching system edges opt into `SafeArea`; components do not silently invent app-shell insets.
- Web consumers load the BeeUI semantic theme CSS as documented in [Web onboarding](/docs/start/web/).

BeeUI components consume semantic tokens and support the current typed variant/density contracts. Use [Theming](/docs/theming/) and [Density](/docs/guides/density/). `className` is an implementation escape hatch for source-owned/application work, not a cross-engine portability guarantee.
